name: Chronicle Forge
description:
Chronicle Forge is a desktop documentary video studio for turning researched topics into short, illustrated and narrated stories.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set up any target length from 5–300 seconds, choose 1–24 scene images and a detailed or stick-figure style. Research a topic: search the web, read source excerpts and choose relevant evidence.
2. Review the story: draft narration with source references, read a model-assisted factual audit, edit the script and approve it yourself.
3. Create media: choose available Anna image and speech models, then generate illustrations and narration. A pipeline monitor shows completed-work percentages, elapsed time and the latest completed illustration. Each scene previews its image and audio as soon as they are ready; image jobs report queue status and can be resumed.
4. Export: preview and download a captioned MP4 at 720p or 1080p. Download subtitles, a thumbnail and script/source notes separately.

SAVE AND RESUME
Download a resumable project containing completed media and any pending image job identifiers. Restore it to continue without purchasing completed assets again. If a provider fails, the app reports the error and retains completed work in the open window.

GETTING STARTED AND COST
Start with the five-second option to test a single scene. Anna credits are used for script, image and speech calls. All AI services are hosted by Anna; no Ollama or local AI model is needed. Video encoding runs on your device using a software encoder downloaded by the browser. Keep the app open during export; longer or 1080p videos need more time and memory.

OUTPUT AND REVIEW
Images are AI illustrations, not archival evidence. The model audit is assistance, not factual verification: check the sources and narration before generating or publishing. Captions use estimated timing within each scene. The optional two-second encoder test creates a labelled test card only and does not generate a documentary. Desktop browsers are required.

STILL IMAGE DEFAULT
Images stay still and show their full edges by default. Fill-frame cropping and gentle zoom are opt-in export settings. Extra downloads are labelled optional. Content-free diagnostics can be downloaded locally; they are never sent automatically.
